report.summary: P-D001 (58M, dual Medicaid/Medicare MCO, transport benefit = yes) needs utilities and transport support. Screener shows no current utility shutoff risk but identifies a transportation need. Home tract 17031260300 is low-income with high no-vehicle share (27.7%) and 25.3% utility-shutoff prevalence. Transit to dialysis (DaVita Park Manor, 15:00) is feasible but long (~84 min; latest departure 13:25).

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Medicaid plan card at least 2 business days before each appointment; patient is eligible (Medicaid member with transport benefit). Good for recurring dialysis trips.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Consider given repeated dialysis no-shows and long fixed-route trip.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides 7 AM-5 PM to medical appointments, but age 60+ required; patient is 58, so NOT currently eligible.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Income-based help with gas and electric bills; apply in person Mon/Wed. Plausibly relevant given low-income tract and dual coverage; patient is not at shutoff risk.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays. Not urgently needed now (screener: no shutoff risk), but keep as backup.
